name: CPI
tagline: Measure what matters in leadership pipeline health.
audience: HR leaders, DEI heads, CHROs, Executive Teams in China-based MNCs and large domestic enterprises
delivery_format: Organizational diagnostic (12Q Lite / 36Q Full), consultant-led debrief, written report
outcome_statement: A clear, benchmarked view of your organization's leadership pipeline health across six dimensions, with a specific pipeline archetype and prioritized action roadmap to close gaps.
use_cases: Baseline pipeline health assessment for DEI strategy formulation
Board-level reporting on gender diversity progress
Pre- and post-intervention measurement of DEI program impact
M&A due diligence on leadership talent infrastructure

response_scales: numeric percentage inputs for representation metrics

dimensions.name: Talent Representation
dimensions.description: Percentage of women in top leadership layers (ExCo and Senior Leadership Team). The most visible measure of pipeline output.

dimensions.name: Pipeline Depth
dimensions.description: Depth and readiness of women in mid-to-senior levels, succession slate diversity, and high-potential identification coverage.

dimensions.name: Development Investment
dimensions.description: Quality and quantity of development programs, stretch assignments, coaching investment, and promotion velocity for women.

dimensions.name: Cultural Alignment
dimensions.description: Degree of inclusive culture, psychological safety, and sense of belonging for women in the organization.

dimensions.name: Retention Risk
dimensions.description: Attrition rates of women relative to men at each level, retention program effectiveness, and turnover risk at key career inflection points.

dimensions.name: External Hiring Capability
dimensions.description: Organization's ability to attract and hire senior women externally, and the balance between external hiring and internal development.

archetypes.name: The Glass Ceiling
archetypes.pattern: High D3 (Development Investment), Low D1 (Talent Representation)
archetypes.summary: Strong development velocity through mid-levels, but structural barriers prevent breakthrough to the executive layer.

archetypes.name: Shallow Bench
archetypes.pattern: High D1 (Talent Representation), Low D2 (Pipeline Depth)
archetypes.summary: Visible senior representation exists but the pipeline beneath is thin — unsustainable depth.

archetypes.name: Cultural Mismatch
archetypes.summary: Structural metrics look good on paper, but day-to-day culture is not genuinely inclusive.

archetypes.name: Leaky Bucket
archetypes.summary: Strong inflow and development, but disproportionate attrition at key career inflection points.

archetypes.name: External Dependency
archetypes.pattern: High D6 (External Hiring), Low D2 (Pipeline Depth)
archetypes.summary: Senior gaps filled primarily through external hiring — weak internal bench masked by external pipeline.
archetypes.primary_strength: Ability to attract senior external talent

archetypes.name: World-Class Pipeline
archetypes.summary: Excellence across all six dimensions — sustainable, high-performing gender-balanced leadership pipeline.

fallback_archetype.name: Balanced Profile
fallback_archetype.note: Fallback when no single archetype pattern dominates. Not counted in the '6 archetypes' product count — it's the residual/default.

cross_pillar_relevance: P2 Cross-Border Leadership Effectiveness — Cultural Alignment dimension feeds cross-border inclusion insights

key_methodological_notes: Dual-tier: Lite (12Q, 2 per dimension) and Full (36Q, 6 per dimension) share the same scoring engine
Composite score is weighted (not simple average) — Representation carries the most weight at 25%
Archetype detection is pattern-based (high/low dimension pairs with minimum gap thresholds), not just highest score
Benchmark data is China-market specific (200 companies, 8 industries)
Results include industry comparison, percentile ranking, and priority-ranked action roadmap

provenance.dimensions: CPI v2.0 scoring engine — DIMENSION_WEIGHTS constant (lines 23-29), names aligned to canon
provenance.archetypes: CPI v2.0 scoring engine — ARCHETYPES constant (6 primary + 1 fallback)
provenance.benchmark: Same source — INDUSTRY_BENCHMARKS constant (8 industries, 200 companies, 25000 profiles)
